body:
The first time I went from powder cocaine to crack was the begining of the downfall of my life.As a young twenty something I had dabbled in drugs from as young as fourteen but nothing was going to prepare me for the fall out of crack.Doing powder had become a weekend ritual go to work get paid go down the pub buy cocaine.Dont get me wrong I liked the buzz of cocaine but I wanted something different,thats when my mate recomended crack.
The first time I was sick,the way we done made me feel like a scumbag,we used a coke can with holes at the bottem end (little pin holes of about12). Ash from a freshly smoked cigarette was sprinkled over the holes and a small pea size of crack placed on top,then with steady hands we lifted our make shift pipe to our face blew all the excess air out of our lungs put the can to our mouths and inhaled from the ready made hole at the top of the can while with the other hand lighting the crack with a clipper lighter.The rush I got was intense so much that it made me gag and within about a minute I was sick,that should of made me give up there and then but the intense rush outweighed all of the downfalls of the drug, within months I was an addict.
All my money on crack All my mates replaced by my new mate, the CRACK MAN.I did'nt even have time for my own family.Spending all my money, all my daughters money on crack ,there was no stopping me,the taste I found was just as addictive as building the best pipe,and the high was the best I had ever known.It got so bad that I would be searching my carpet trying to find any tiny crumb of crack that I may have dropped,nine times out of ten I would end up mistaken bits of paint flakes or rice crispie grains thinking that it was crack and becoming upset even sometimes reduced to tears because it was'nt.Crack what a glamorous drug eh.
All them days are behind me know but I wont lie to you,the feeling I got from crack was unbelievable but it came with a price it cost me my family my money my job.I look back know and think did the intense rush really outweigh the downfalls.
